## 02 / SELECTED WORK

### AFIM

**Persistent context infrastructure for AI systems.**

AI tools forget too much between conversations, applications, and agents. AFIM explores how useful context can move with the user instead of remaining trapped inside individual sessions.

```text
CONTEXT → MEMORY → PORTABILITY → AGENTS
```

Working across conversation export, session continuity, cross-tool context, MCP-style interfaces, multi-agent communication, and user-controlled memory.

`TypeScript` · `Next.js` · `Chrome APIs` · `MCP` · `AI Agents`

[Live system →](https://afim-phi.vercel.app/)

---

### SOCRA

**AI-assisted learning infrastructure for university courses.**

SOCRA is an undergraduate research and engineering project at the University at Buffalo exploring how AI can support learning workflows without turning the product into a thin wrapper around an LLM.

I work across the system architecture — frontend flows, backend APIs, authentication, permissions, model integration, telemetry, deployment, and scaling considerations for classroom use.

```text
STUDENT
   ↓
LEARNING WORKFLOW
   ↓
APPLICATION LAYER
   ↓
AI / MODEL LAYER
   ↓
FEEDBACK + TELEMETRY
```

`Next.js` · `Python` · `FastAPI` · `PostgreSQL` · `Supabase` · `Docker`

**Status:** active research + engineering

---

### OPENCLAW BRIDGE

**A local-first interface between personal services and an AI agent.**

Built around a simple constraint: useful agents need access to real tools, but credentials and execution should not automatically move into someone else's infrastructure.

The project explores authenticated access to services such as GitHub and Gmail while keeping the agent runtime local.

```text
SERVICES → AUTH → LOCAL AGENT → MODEL
```

`TypeScript` · `Next.js` · `OAuth` · `Auth0` · `Ollama`

[Repository →](https://github.com/atshalahmedkhan/open-claw)

---

### REVERE

**Wearable AI prototype for contextual assistance.**

A glasses-mounted Raspberry Pi prototype combining vision and audio to explore how a wearable system could recognize familiar people and provide contextual prompts.

The interesting part was not just the model — it was integrating sensing, inference, hardware constraints, cloud services, and real-time interaction into one working prototype.

`Raspberry Pi` · `Computer Vision` · `MediaPipe` · `Firebase` · `ElevenLabs`

[Project →](https://github.com/ishitaramrayka/Revere)

```text
     classroom workflows · experimentation · scale

03   AI SYSTEMS
     persistent memory · context portability
     agent coordination · model behavior

04   DATA + EXPERIMENTATION
     pipelines · statistical analysis
     reproducible engineering workflows
```

My research interests are increasingly centered on one question:

> **How do we build intelligent systems that remain useful when they leave the demo and enter the real world?**

That means thinking beyond model output — about infrastructure, data, interfaces, reliability, evaluation, privacy, and the humans actually using the system.

## 04 / ENGINEERING

I have worked on production education software across both frontend and backend systems.

```text
FRONTEND
React · Next.js · TypeScript

BACKEND
Python · Django · FastAPI · REST APIs

SYSTEMS
authentication · permissions · data flows
course workflows · asynchronous state

QUALITY
regression testing · Cypress E2E
production debugging · root-cause analysis
```

A lot of the engineering I enjoy starts when the obvious fix does not work.

Tracing state across components, understanding how data moved through a system, reproducing edge cases, and fixing the underlying behavior is usually more interesting to me than simply shipping another UI component.
